integrity: The proof is symbolic. The verifier reconstructs false-twin quotients and field-order multisets across 69 finite profiles only as corroboration.
scientific_limitations: The reconstruction theorem is restricted to finite reduced commutative rings that are not fields.
No claim is made that a nonreduced ring cannot have an isomorphic cozero-divisor graph.
Fields are necessarily excluded because their cozero-divisor graphs are all empty.
An earlier 2010 paper was verified at issue/year level, but the earliest inspected source with exact day-level bibliographic evidence and algebraic subject classification is dated 2012-07-20.
title: Cozero-divisor graphs determine finite reduced nonfield rings
